subject: AuditBridge integration: pen test evidence ingestion & delivery plan
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@auditbridge.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: carter@redshieldlabs.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AuditBridge onboarding: SOC2/pen test evidence ingestion for CloudShield

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the intro. I’m Sofia on the AuditBridge onboarding team — we’ll be ingesting the pen test deliverables from RedShield into the customer GRC workspace for CloudShield. Carter (RedShield) is doing the assessment and will push evidence bundles to the transfer location you confirm.

High level ask from our side: we need a stable transfer method (S3 prefix or SFTP), a sample evidence manifest (CSV), and the retention/TTL requirements so our pipeline can map fields properly. Can your team provide:

- Preferred transfer endpoint (S3 prefix with role, or SFTP host)
- Example manifest or mapping guide for filenames -> evidence types
- Any required metadata (KMS key alias, account id, region)

We have a checklist attached for the initial ingest (evidence-manifest-sample.csv). Will schedule a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Onboarding Manager, AuditBridge
sofia.ramos@auditbridge.io
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@auditbridge.io>, carter@redshieldlabs.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuditBridge onboarding: SOC2/pen test evidence ingestion for CloudShield

Sofia — thanks, and welcome. Quick answers below and I’ve attached our network diagram and a scoping template that might speed up Carter’s packaging.

Transfer options (preferred order):
1) S3 (preferred): bucket redwood-evidence-transfer, prefix /cloudshield/rdw-2026-pen/ — we’ll create a cross-account role for auditbridge-ingest@auditbridge (ARN will be provided after we confirm the HS record).
2) SFTP (fallback): sftp.audit-transfer.redwood.ai — create user, provide keys.

Required metadata we need in the manifest: evidence_id, evidence_type (logs/config/screenshots), timestamp_utc, md5_hash, originating_system (e.g., redshield), md5, file_size_bytes. TTL for ingested evidence: 540 days (SOC2 baseline) unless CloudShield asks for longer; please confirm.

Attachments: rdw_network_diagram_v2.pdf, pen-test-scoping-template.xlsx (scoping sheet has the mapping we expect).

Next steps: Carter — can RedShield produce one sample package (<= 50MB) with the manifest by Feb 16 so AuditBridge can validate the pipeline? If yes, we’ll provision a short-lived role and share the S3 prefix + presigned put policy.

Jonas Weber
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@auditbridge.io>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuditBridge onboarding: SOC2/pen test evidence ingestion for CloudShield

Adding a few security constraints from RedTeam/compliance:
- KMS: any S3 objects must be encrypted with alias/redwood-prod-evidence (we can grant Encrypt/Decrypt to the cross-account role).
- Principle of least privilege: role will only have s3:PutObject to the scoped prefix and s3:ListBucket limited by prefix.
- Evidence retention policy: 540 days default; for pen test raw findings we ask for 3650 days (archive) — but we can set different lifecycle for /raw/ vs /reports/. Please confirm the desired split.
- Audit logs: enable CloudTrail for put-object events to the bucket and share the trail ARN with AuditBridge for their records.

Also please ensure any PII is redacted by RedShield before upload — our legal team will require an attest statement.

-Marissa
Director, Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Carter Lin <carter@redshieldlabs.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@auditbridge.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuditBridge onboarding: SOC2/pen test evidence ingestion for CloudShield

Thanks — we’ll produce the sample package. A couple of clarifying notes from the pen test side:
- We normally include a small findings-report.pdf, a raw-logs/ directory (pcap + app logs), and screenshots/ where applicable. We’ll add the manifest CSV at the root.
- RedShield requests the ability to upload via SFTP in case customer environments block cross-account S3 access. Which upload method would you like us to validate first?

Action: sample package targeted for 2026-02-16 EOD. We’ll redact PII and include an attest.txt signed by our project lead.

Carter Lin
Head of Assessments, RedShield Labs
carter@redshieldlabs.com
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Carter Lin <carter@redshieldlabs.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@auditbridge.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuditBridge onboarding: SOC2/pen test evidence ingestion for CloudShield

Carter — perfect, thanks. We provisioned a short-lived cross-account role and created the S3 prefix for the sample. Presigned write policy below (valid 48h).

S3 prefix: s3://redwood-evidence-transfer/cloudshield/rdw-2026-pen/sample-upload/
Presigned PUT policy (expires 2026-02-18T14:22:00Z): https://s3-presign.redwood.ai/put/abc123

I’ve also uploaded an example manifest and a small stub evidence package at: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-internal-evidence/cloudshield/2026-02-16/evidence-package.zip
Attachments included: evidence-manifest-sample.csv (shows required columns), rdw_network_diagram_v2.pdf. HubSpot record for the engagement: https://hubspot.com/contacts/record/HS-45219

Marissa — retention split: we’ll store /raw/ for 3650 days and /reports/ for 540 days. Audit logs are enabled and we’ll share the trail ARN once processed.

Jonas
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@auditbridge.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, Carter Lin <carter@redshieldlabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AuditBridge onboarding: SOC2/pen test evidence ingestion for CloudShield

Received and validated. AuditBridge pipeline accepted the sample manifest and mapped fields correctly; sample import job finished without errors. We noted two minor filename mappings (screenshots -> image_screens) which we fixed on our side — no further action required from RedShield.

Next: we’ll mark the onboarding task complete in AuditBridge and assign continuous-sync jobs for weekly ingestion. I’ll send the assignment link and a short onboarding summary to CloudShield’s security contact.

Thanks everyone — smooth handoff.

Sofia
